# Foundational Bio

> Foundational Bio runs an AI-native, vertically integrated lab that offers sequencing as a repeatable service. Customers send plates and receive data, with lower cost, faster turnaround, and fewer errors. Plates in, data out.

For research use only (RUO). Not for use in diagnostic procedures.

## Services

- WGS (whole-genome sequencing): available now
- WES (whole-exome sequencing): coming soon
- RNA-seq (transcriptome sequencing): coming soon
- ppmSeq (part-per-million variant detection): coming soon
- Methyl-seq (methylation sequencing): on the roadmap
- Beyond sequencing: shaped with development partners

## Ordering

- Minimum order: one 96-well plate
- 50% up front reserves your run
- Request a quote at https://foundational.bio/#book; we reply within one business day
- Contact: info@foundational.bio

## The lab

Samples are processed on purpose-built, scalable lab hardware by robots powered by custom physical AI models. A software platform orchestrates every run. Only robots touch samples, with human oversight.

- Scalable lab hardware: modular, AI-native workstations that add capacity one unit at a time
- Physical AI models: models that see, plan, and execute wet-lab protocols on real hardware
- Software platform: orchestrates every run and keeps track of everything in the lab
- Full traceability: every action on every sample is machine-executed and machine-logged, from intake to delivered data
